title: cross-sdk: unify streaming ergonomics + auth refresh + retry backoffs (py/ts/go)
author: Asha Patel
ci_checks: python-tests: failed on first run (flake in tests/test_stream_iter.py) -> rerun -> pass (run/5421)

description: This PR implements a coordinated, cross-SDK set of ergonomics and bugfixes across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs to achieve API parity for streaming responses, standardize auth token refresh behavior, and harden retry/backoff semantics. Motivation: customers reported inconsistent streaming iterators across SDKs (different resume semantics and memory characteristics), token refresh edge cases that caused silent 401s under load, and divergent default retry curves between SDKs that made cross-service behavior unpredictable. Changes included: (1) new lightweight stream iterator/async iterator patterns for Python/TS and a channel-based wrapper for Go that share a documented resume/reconnect contract; (2) centralizing token refresh hooks so SDKs auto-retry once after refresh on authorization failures and surface a single on_auth_refresh callback; (3) harmonizing default retry/backoff parameters (initial 100ms, multiplier 1.5, max 5s) and exposing them via client config; (4) improved test coverage for interrupted streams and server-initiated reconnects; (5) bumped SDK versions: python 0.16.0, typescript 0.12.0, go 0.9.0; (6) updated examples and migration notes. The description below lists commits, changed areas, test matrix notes, and review threads. Note: We intentionally kept public surface changes minimal; most consumer-facing change is the new reconnector behavior which is opt-in by default for older clients and enabled for new minor versions. Migration notes and code examples are in docs/ and examples/ with inline comments.
